messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High-severity tail latency alert for prod/cluster-7 on route /v1/stream. p95=1.4s p99=5.0s, streaming stalls and paging errors increasing. incident_id=INC-2026-04-19-1948124680
maria.g: i'm on-call, ack. pulling dashboards and traces now https://internal.redwood/obs/cluster7/streams 
leo: quick checks: eviction spike visible. running metrics: `sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by(node)` and `sum(rate(prefill_requests_total[1m])) by(route)`
leo: nodes n3 and n8 showing eviction spikes (~520/min). /v1/stream prefill_requests jumped ~7x.
anya: traces show repeated KV page misses followed by disk_fetch waits during decode. pattern: prefill flood -> working-set churn -> decoder KV misses -> streaming stalls.
sam.k: any deploys or autoscaler events?
deploy-bot: no deploys in last 2h. autoscaler: no scale-up recorded in 90m.
customer-success: two enterprise customers reported elevated p99 and one opened a support ticket citing stream timeouts. tagging them high-touch.
maria.g: initial mitigation slate (low-risk first): 1) throttle prefill concurrency on cluster-7 2) lighten eviction aggressiveness 3) route a slice of long streams to smaller model 4) enable disk-fallback on hot nodes. comments?
sam.k: agree. throttle prefill first. leo, can you push a conservative change?
leo: applying runtime config patch to reduce prefill concurrency: 
```
kubectl -n redwood patch configmap runtime-prefill --patch '{"data":{"prefill.conf":"max_inflight=3
window_ms=50"}}'
```
leo: patch applied; pods will pick up config within ~45s.
ops-bot: initiating rolling update for runtime flag `--kv-evict-threshold` from 0.60 -> 0.82 on pool cluster-7. 1 node at a time.
anya: applying routing split: /v1/stream -> 75% rdx-gen-7, 25% rdx-small-1 for 20m. config snippet: 
```
route /v1/stream { split: [{variant: rdx-gen-7, weight: 75}, {variant: rdx-small-1, weight: 25}] }
```
leo: enabling feature flag `runtime.feature.disk_kv_fallback=true` on nodes n3,n8 to reduce tail from disk hits. flipping now.
maria.g: snapshot before changes: p95=1400ms p99=5000ms stall_rate=1.0/min eviction_rate_hot~=520/min
6m after throttling + eviction bump:
anya: p95 -> 360ms, p99 -> 950ms, stall_rate -> 0.18/min. eviction rate on n3/n8 dropped to ~30/min. decode queue depth normalized.
customer-success: one affected tenant confirmed streams restored; others reporting improved performance.
sam.k: good signal. handoff: i'll watch for next 2hrs after maria rotates out. please list follow-ups for RCA.
maria.g: follow-ups: - keep prefill.max_inflight=3 for 60m - keep eviction threshold elevated for 2h - revert routing split after 20m if stable - collect traces/logs for RCA - customer comms: send interim update.
leo: saving config diffs to ops-runbook and capturing `kubectl rollout status` outputs. also leaving rollback snippet.
anya: collecting spans and flamegraphs. building small reproducer: synthetic workload that pulses prefill at 10x while slowing decoder to reproduce eviction->stall pattern. saving script to /playbooks/repro/prefill-thrash.sh
sre-rotation: assigning postmortem owner to @anya. timeline: opened 1948124680, mitigations applied 1948124745, major improvement 1948124960.
ops-bot: rolling update complete on 3/4 nodes; 1 node pending due to pod eviction (expected ~90s).
sam.k: metrics check after 30m: p95=220ms p99=410ms stall_rate=0.05/min disk-fallback_hits ~1.3%. no regressions detected.
customer-success: interim note drafted and sent to impacted tenants offering RCA and optional call.
maria.g: any blockers for leaving mitigations in-place for the observation window?
leo: no blockers. note: need to instrument `prefill_eviction_ratio` metric (evictions / prefill_requests) and alert when >0.2 for 5m.
anya: long-term RCA action items: - implement adaptive prefill backpressure tied to decoder queue depth - add per-route prefill budgets/priorities - evaluate segmented/pinned caching to protect decoder-critical keys - add synthetic staging test for prefill+slow-decode scenario.
sam.k: I'll monitor for 2hrs and if stable revert runtime.feature.disk_kv_fallback flag and routing split. leaving thread open until that completes.
maria.g: thanks all. incident classified Sev2. postmortem owner @anya. closing primary incident window at 1948125025 if no regressions.
anya: acknowledged, will post RCA doc link when ready.
sre-rotation: closing note: incident resolved for now; follow-ups tracked in the RCA and ops runbook. :white_check_mark:
